title: Spillover-Aware Multi-Value Steering for Pluralistic LLM Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on pluralistic value alignment in LLMs, utilizing moral psychology frameworks such as Moral Foundations Theory. It evaluates steering models along specific value dimensions including 'FutureEthics', 'SocialJustice', and conducts a full replication study entirely on a 'Medical Ethics' domain incorporating the Beauchamp-Childress principles (Autonomy, Beneficence, Non-maleficence, Justice).
